title: Absent from scheduled technical session — next steps & proposed times
text:
Absent from scheduled technical session — next steps & proposed times

["From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Rita Gomez <rita.gomez@stellarsolutions.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Absent from scheduled technical session — next steps & proposed times

Hi Rita —

We missed you for the 10:30 AM PST technical session. I wanted to check in quickly to see whether now is still a good time to reconnect or if you'd prefer we reschedule. No worries if something came up — we can be flexible.

If you’re available, quick options for tomorrow/this week that would work for our SE (Diego) and product lead (Lauren):
- Tue 5/18: 3:00–4:00 PM PDT
- Wed 5/19: 9:00–10:00 AM PDT
- Thu 5/20: 11:00 AM–12:00 PM PDT

Short agenda (30–45 min):
1) 10-min context & goals from Stellar
2) 20-min hands-on runthrough of our inference flow (latency/cost controls, batching, routing)
3) 10-min integration & next steps (data, security questions)

Attaching a quick demo checklist and an Integration Questions doc to help prep. If none of those slots work, tell me two windows that do and we’ll make it happen.

Thanks — I’ll hold Diego’s calendar for the Wednesday morning slot unless you tell me otherwise.

Cheers,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Absent from scheduled technical session — next steps & proposed times

Hi Olga —

So sorry — an urgent ops issue came in and I had to jump on a call. Thank you for checking. We’re definitely still interested; Wednesday morning (5/19) looks promising for me. I could do 9:00–9:30 but might need until 10:00 depending on follow-up.

A couple quick asks before we lock: can Diego cover expected tokenization behavior for our PDFs and any recommendations for low-latency embedding retrieval? Also — is there a brief checklist we should run on our side so the demo can be productive?

Thanks,
Rita
Head of ML Engineering, Stellar Solutions
rita.gomez@stellarsolutions.com | +1 (617) 555-0199', 'From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Rita Gomez <rita.gomez@stellarsolutions.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Absent from scheduled technical session — next steps & proposed times

Thanks for the quick reply, Rita — glad Wednesday morning works.

Diego will lead the technical portion and can cover tokenization, embedding retrieval and low-latency patterns. Lauren plans to join the first 10 minutes for context and success criteria.

Let’s tentatively confirm:
- When: Wednesday, 2027-05-19 at 09:00 AM PDT (we’ll block until 09:45 in case we need the extra 15 minutes)
- Who: Rita (Stellar) + Olga (AE), Diego (SE), Lauren (Product)

Agenda (we’ll keep to 30–40 minutes):
- 00–10 min: Goals & success metrics (Rita / Stellar)
- 10–30 min: Live demo — inference flow, batching, KV cache, and cost controls (Diego)
- 30–35 min: Integration considerations & data security notes (Olga/Diego)
- 35–40 min: Next steps & mutual action plan

Prep checklist (attached again):
- 1–2 example PDF inputs (anonymized) or small sample dataset (CSV)
- A short description of expected throughput (requests/sec) and latency targets
- Any compliance constraints (PII handling, regional residency)

I’ve reattached the demo checklist and a short Integration Questions doc. If you can share even a tiny sample PDF and a note on throughput, Diego can prep targeted performance knobs to show.

If you prefer a slightly later range (09:30–10:00), reply and we’ll shift. Otherwise I’ll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and the run-of-show.

Best,
Olga
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

To: Rita Gomez <rita.gomez@stellarsolutions.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Absent from scheduled technical session — next steps & proposed times

Hi Rita —

I’m Diego, SE on this call. Thanks for the note — 09:00 works for me and I’ll focus the demo on two things you called out:

1) Tokenization & PDFs: we’ll show how we handle PDF text extraction and tokenization edge cases (tables, multi-column), and I’ll demonstrate a quick sanitization step to reduce PII leakage. Please bring a redacted sample PDF if possible.

2) Low-latency embedding retrieval: I’ll show a caching pattern and an index layout that keeps 95th percentile latency under your target while reducing per-token cost. If you can share expected qps and a typical doc size, I’ll tune the example.

Small ask before the call: drop a ~10-line example of a PDF-extracted chunk or a small CSV here or upload to the Drive link Olga included. That will let me precompile a short demo so we don’t spend time on data wrangling during the session.

See you at 09:00 — I’ll open the Zoom and post the link in the calendar invite.

—Diego
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147']
